findings.subject: how a module decides it is the process entrypoint
findings.why: Six CLI modules answer the same question three ways. Two of the three disagree with the third on real inputs: a repo path containing a space, and an absent process.argv[1].

positions.statement: Compare import.meta.url to pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href — correct URL encoding, but throws when argv[1] is absent.
The same comparison wrapped in try/catch, yielding false rather than throwing when argv[1] is absent.
String-concatenate file:// onto argv[1], then fall back to matching the filename suffix.
